description: December 3 birthday meaning: Sagittarius decan 2, birthday number 3, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a December 3 birthday falls in Sagittarius, in the second decan, with Jupiter as the sign's ruler and Mars as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 3. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Sagittarius is mutable and fire.

sections.heading: December 3 zodiac sign and personality
paragraphs: Eleven degrees of Sagittarius gives December 3 a Mars-flavoured decan, energetic and direct, while the birthday number 3 contributes playfulness and verbal flair. Together, the systems describe a lively, outspoken personality who enjoys a spirited debate, tells stories with energy and tends to make plain speaking sound like entertainment rather than criticism.

On December 3 the Sun usually sits at about 11° Sagittarius, in the second decan, where Mars is the sub-ruler alongside Jupiter. Mars, ruler of Aries, acts as sub-ruler for the middle of Sagittarius, roughly December 2 to December 11. The sign's love of freedom picks up a sharper, more competitive edge. Early-December birthdays are frequently linked with bold, energetic people who are quick to champion a cause, whether on a playing field, in a debate or on the road. Their honesty may be direct enough to startle. Mars brings drive and courage, along with impatience when life moves slowly. Channelled well, this mix of vision and nerve makes for a natural pioneer, someone willing to test an idea in the real world.

sections.heading: December 3 in numerology
paragraphs: Born on the 3rd, you carry a birthday number of 3 in its simplest form. As a supporting number, the day of birth is read as a gift that shows in everyday style rather than in the larger direction of a life. The single-digit 3 is traditionally associated with expression: talking, writing, making things, finding the joke in a heavy afternoon. Its energy is light and spontaneous, often called youthful whatever the person's age. Numerologists tend to suggest that 3s benefit from finishing what they begin, because their ideas are worth more completed than merely sketched in a notebook.

The Life Path, the main number in a numerology chart, also uses the birth year, so it changes from one December 3 birthday to the next: it is 4 for 1960, 5 for 1970, 6 for 1980 and 7 for 1990, for example. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 11.

sections.heading: Born on December 3: season, famous birthdays and Chinese zodiac
paragraphs: December birthdays arrive at the start of northern winter, around the shortest days and the year's festivities, and at the start of summer in the southern hemisphere. Sagittarius holds most of the month, with Capricorn beginning around December 21 or 22. In numerology December is month 12, which reduces to 3: expression and sociability, built from the 1 and 2 of initiative and partnership. December 3 is the 337th day of the year (338th in a leap year). By December 22, 19 days later, the Sun has usually moved on into Capricorn.

For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by December 3, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year. Well-known people born on December 3 include Joseph Conrad (1857), Julianne Moore (1960) and Ozzy Osbourne (1948).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is December 3?
faq.answer: December 3 is Sagittarius in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the second decan of Sagittarius, which tradition links with Mars.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on December 3?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On December 3 the Life Path is 4 in 1960, 5 in 1970, 6 in 1980, 7 in 1990, 8 in 2000, 9 in 2010 and 1 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 3 for everyone born on the 3rd.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on December 3?
faq.answer: Chinese astrology is straightforward for a December 3 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on December 3?
faq.answer: December 3 is also the birthday of Joseph Conrad (1857), Julianne Moore (1960) and Ozzy Osbourne (1948). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
